newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyo Trust sets terms on Euro subordinated bonds.
newsitem.headline: Toyo Trust sets terms on Euro subordinated bonds.

text.p: Toyo Trust & Banking Co Ltd said on Thursday that it set terms on 50 billion yen of Euroyen perpetual subordinated bonds to be issued through its overseas unit, TTB Finance Cayman Ltd.

The coupon rate on the bonds, to be issued at par, will be 0.75 percent from June 20, 1997 to September 30, 2002, and 2.5 percent above the six-month yen LIBOR (London Interbank Offered Rate) from September 30, 2002.
Toyo Trust will guarantee the bonds.
The subordinated bonds will be exchangeable with the firm's ordinary stock at an exchange price of 831 yen. The exchange period is from July 1, 1997 to September 20, 2002.
Toyo Trust itself will issue 50 billion yen worth of convertible bonds in order to prepare for the exchange.
The payment date is June 20 and interest will be paid annually at end-March and end-September.
